primary.label: Franchise primary
primary.description: Aidan's serious Franchise save. Primary team TBD — set later with `config --game madden27 --primary-team <NFL team>`. Until then prep/play run the unassigned meta scheme pack.

lab.label: Franchise lab
lab.description: Optional practice/lab save (mirrors CFB ohio_state). Freer experiments; strong postgame results promote to the primary profile.

online_baseline.note: Scheme-first inventory, not a locked team identity. 6 D + 2 O = 8/8 Active for USER games (Aidan cap). CPU games = offense-only (O macros only).

scheme_pack.label: Unassigned primary scheme pack
scheme_pack.offense_source: Buccaneers (community #1 launch O) + Shotgun Classic / Chargers concepts as prep deltas
scheme_pack.defense_source: 49ers / Titans Saleh 4-3 (community top launch D) with flexible nickel
scheme_pack.note: Meta scheme, NOT Aidan's Franchise team. When a primary team is set, prep retargets deltas; personas and call language stay the same.

doctrine_priors.offense: Clamp Stack + Trips X Nasty home; run Inside Zone / Stretch vs two-high; quick stack/rub answers vs man; 5WR Tight Mtn concepts on money downs.
doctrine_priors.defense_default: Nickel Mug home (Cover 4 Quarters / Cover 3 Match / Cover 2 Sink). One user job. Schematic mug pressure (DB Fire 2) selectively — never mindless contain-four. Macros situational, not every snap.
doctrine_priors.prediction_rule: One tell = log + mild bump. Targeted macro only on REPEATED tendency (2+) this game in similar D&D.

Gun Bunch.why: Shotgun Classic Gun Bunch — rub/stack answers vs man + pressure (launch #1 scheme book).

Gun Empty.why: Shotgun Classic Gun Empty — 3rd-long vs single-high / C2-C3 mixers.

Gun Tight Offset TE.why: Tight gun run-first set — Inside Zone / Stretch vs two-high users, PA Flood off it.

split_field_zone.offense: Two-high/split-field user: run first (Inside Zone / Stretch), Mesh + Ohio Return underneath; don't force Vert Smash into safeties.
split_field_zone.defense: Explosive shot + scramble persona: Cover 4 Quarters home; MATCH-4 after repeated verticals; SPY after repeated scrambles.

pressure_heavy.offense: Pressure persona: O-PROT ready, quick stack/rub answers (Mesh, Stick Wheel, Quick Slants); Gun Bunch changeup.
pressure_heavy.defense: Crossers + bubbles + scramble persona: Cover 3 Match / Cover 2 Sink; MESH-RAT / SPY on repeats.

c2_c3_mixer.offense: C2/C3 mixer: Flood Sail / PA Flood vs single-high, Double Post vs C2; possession in RZ.
c2_c3_mixer.defense: Compressed + GL persona: STACK vs Clamp/bunch repeats; don't sell out run at GL.

two_high_money_downs.offense: CPU two-high on money downs: take free underneath (Mesh, Ohio Return, Stick) and run; no forced shots into sticks coverage.

unknown.offense: Thin persona: meta baseline as-is — establish run, easy stack completions.
unknown.defense: Thin persona: Nickel Mug home, no macros until repeated tells this game.

call_syntax.offense: Formation — Play | Adj if needed | Read1 → Read2
call_syntax.defense: Formation — Play | Macro if needed | User one job

examples.offense: Gun Doubles Clamp Stack — Motion Shuffle Vert Smash | No adj | Corner → Shuffle HB
examples.defense: Nickel Mug — Cover 4 Quarters | MATCH-4 | User #3 seam

call_syntax.controller: Xbox — formation/play/macro NAMES only. Never invent button sequences.
